closedProjection: aria-expanded=false; panel unmounted by default, or hidden/noninteractive if the source keepMounted option is explicitly chosen.
semantics:
Project drawer

Review the project details before saving.
keyboardAndFocus: The default modal drawer contains focus, supports Escape/Close and restores the trigger focus. Pointer swipes use the configured direction and primitive gesture logic; keyboard access remains available through explicit controls.
sourceRule: The wrapper defaults modal=true, swipeDirection=down and showSwipeHandle=false. Snap points are viewport fractions, pixels or px/rem strings as declared by the primitive. A snap-point change does not imply dismissal. Only a source-reported eligible swipe requests open=false; callback cancellation and controlled props still govern acceptance.
protocol: SCXML consumes source-normalized interaction/callback transactions. eventDetails is the source callback object. onOpenChange/onValueChange sends project those observed callbacks, never dispatch a second DOM event. _effect.* entries are internal source focus/application effects, not public component events. Controlled SET_OPEN/SET_VALUE synchronizes props without fabricating a callback.
actualModalityProjection: The pinned Base UI implementation does not emit aria-modal by default. Its modal prop owns focus containment and outside aria-hidden/inert behavior. This source reference does not invent an aria-modal attribute; it is not a universal ARIA conformance certificate.
ownership: Trigger/popup IDs, labels and descriptions belong to this exact instance. Modal ownership cannot be inferred from edge placement or shared globally across unrelated popups.

root.description: Owns open/modal state without a DOM root.

overlay.description: Actual modal backdrop; Sheet owns its unexported internal wrapper through Content.

title.description: Actual heading named by primitive relation.

portal.description: Portal ownership, not a styled anatomy element.

close.description: Native close action, including optional internal icon close.

viewport.description: Primitive viewport, separate from focus popup.

body.description: Primitive content container, not the outer popup.

swipe-handle.description: Optional hidden grip; no independent button behavior.
